subtitle: Sonic Dimension — Five Living Audio Worlds
changes: Expanded Sovereign Reactor IV into Sonic Dimension with five original Canvas2D environments: Nebula Collapse, Cyber Tunnel, Celestial Gate, Ember Storm and Frozen Aurora, rendered from measured local audio or permissioned input

Added an opt-in world mode that preserves all six classic Reactor IV visual modes, local media backdrops, visual overlays, effect routing, saved presets, GIF/PNG/silent video exports and existing playback sources
Introduced user-adjustable real bass and frequency reactivity, beat-driven color transitions and optional automatic world evolution after eight measured beats with a twelve-second minimum interval
Connected Sonic Dimension to the v3.5 Convergence scene palette with live cross-studio color updates and a separate versioned local settings backup
Added settings import/export, save-to-Project Hub, new legacy preset round-tripping, and optional Sync Bridge / Recovery Center backup of Sonic plus Convergence preferences

Retained the PC/iPhone adaptive interface, browser privacy, original Github Pages URL, 18 existing companion spaces and all prior retirement decisions, with no external audio recording or unauthorized system audio capture
Maintained GitHub release validation, deployment verification, rollback cache and the pre-existing automatic Discord announcement sender unchanged
